key_reasoning.reason: Touches 4-5 components across two layers for one feature: MCPServerActions (confirmation UI + per-row disabled state), useMCPManagement (cloningIds/cloningRef double-dispatch guard), mcpStore.cloneConfig (new store method mirroring createConfig), columnRenderers wiring, and MCPManagementPage prop threading.
